page: UpCloud PREMIUM-64xCPU-384GB is a KVM-hypervised server configured with 64 vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding 6.0 GB of memory per core. It runs on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9575F processor with a base speed of 2.0 GHz, featuring 64 physical cores and a single thread per core. The CPU allocation is shared. The system includes 500 GB of local SSD storage and one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench. It demonstrates exceptional memory bandwidth for cached read-only small blocks, alongside strong uncached read and write memory bandwidth. Cryptographic and vector execution capabilities are supported by AVX-512 and SHA instruction sets. The server also achieves top-tier results in software compilation, ray tracing, and Redis SET operations, which reached 164.99 million operations per second.

While the shared CPU allocation presents a potential tradeoff for sustained peak workloads, the high resource density of 64 cores and 384 GB RAM provides strong qualitative cost efficiency for multi-tenant or bursty enterprise applications. The server is highly suited for large-scale database operations, static web serving, software compilation pipelines, and medium-sized LLM inference tasks.
